title: rhododendron campylogynum var. charopoeum
intro: Rhododendron campylogynum var. charopoeum, commonly known as the Himalayan rhododendron, is a plant species belonging to the Rhododendron genus. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Rhododendron campylogynum var. charopoeum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
